content.short: Kuma Wallet is a cross-chain wallet for managing assets across EVM and WASM chains.
content.description: Kuma Wallet enables cross-chain asset management and transfers between EVM and WASM chains, unifying the experience of moving tokens across diverse ecosystems. It is designed to be smooth and intuitive for handling cross-chain assets, prioritizing decentralization and an open-source ethos to reinforce trust, transparency, and security. The wallet offers a secure, user-friendly platform for signing messages and interacting with dapps, delivering a seamless, reliable user experience across all supported networks and assets.
